video_title: Why I Left the NBA to Play in Greece

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on his decision to play for Aris Thessaloniki
quotes.excerpt: This year I'll be playing for Aris Thessaloniki. I'm actually back home in Greece. I'm loving it.
quotes.quote: This year I'll be playing for Aris Thessaloniki. I'm actually back home in Greece. I'm loving it. It's amazing. The fans are, this is one of the reasons I started playing basketball. This is going to be an amazing season. I just feel it.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on the unique passion of Greek basketball fans
quotes.excerpt: I wish any player that plays this sport could get a chance to play for one month.
quotes.quote: Me being back home, I'm loving it. I wish any player that plays this sport could get a chance to play for one month in Greece to understand what the love of playing basketball is there and how it is, especially for these teams. I'm playing in a pretty good team.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on the high demand for Aris Thessaloniki tickets
quotes.excerpt: You don't understand, tickets are sold out. Jerseys are sold out. You can't get anything.
quotes.quote: You don't understand, tickets are sold out. Jerseys are sold out. You can't get anything. Like we even as players we're trying to get some and they're like, guys, we've built this team and now we can't get anything. We can't get anything, you know, and it's special.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on the factors behind his career decisions
quotes.excerpt: It was a lot of components. It was the team, it was my family, then it was Milwaukee.
quotes.quote: I don't think people understand how tough a decision it was and then it became an easier. There was a lot of components. It was the team, it was my family, then it was Milwaukee, what I've been through with Milwaukee and the fans and everything, you know, and then Greece. And it was, and I thought about it so much, I was like, you know what, I mean this, that, you know, just the top it all was what do I want?

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on the winning mentality of his teams
quotes.excerpt: Whatever we go, we win. That's what we do. We don't play to just play.
quotes.quote: Whatever we go, we win. That's what we do. That's why I don't know any other way. That's how we play. That's why we play. We don't play to just play. That's why you see, you know, we start with defense first, we do all the hustle, we do all these things because we know that's what it takes to win. Doesn't matter what nobody says.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on his role as a big brother
quotes.excerpt: I'm a brother before a basketball player. I'm a big brother before anything else.
quotes.quote: I'm a brother before a basketball player. I don't know how you want to connect me towards basketball and I'm a big brother before anything else. I'm a son, I'm a, you know, all these others, I'm a before anything else. You know, like to have to make sure that everybody's okay, you know, plays a big role.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on his desire to assist his younger brother Alex
quotes.excerpt: I almost fumbled because I wanted to give him an assist. I was looking for him.
quotes.quote: I almost fumbled because I wanted to give him an assist. I was looking for him the whole game just like, let me get him one, let me get him one because I know my dad is watching. Like I know for a fact that if my dad would have watched me do this.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on creating your own path in basketball
quotes.excerpt: Stop thinking where do you fit with everybody else left and right and start creating your own mountain.
quotes.quote: Stop thinking where do you fit with everybody else left and right and start creating your own mountain. What is the thing that you do that nobody's even close to? I could give you three things. Three things, right away.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on his reputation among teammates
quotes.excerpt: 95 or 99% of my teammates would say I'm one of the best teammates they ever had.
quotes.quote: You can ask anybody ever, 95 or 99% of my teammates would say I'm one of the best teammates they ever had. Why? Because that's how I am as a person. Very dependable. I know how to do, I know I know locker room, I know how to lead in the locker room. I understand how to do a few something and that leads to winning.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on the disrespect towards Rudy Gobert
quotes.excerpt: To think that Rudy Gobert or any other player, basketball player, that he sucks is wild.
quotes.quote: That is to me, to think that Rudy Gobert or any other player, basketball player, that he sucks is wild. Because think about this, he gets paid to play basketball. And you know what's crazier is that people are like, he is paid by a very wealthy human being, whoever owns that team, to play basketball. That person who is paying them is wealthy for a reason. They're not just throwing money at bad players.
